WITH customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    customer.CustomerKey AS customer_key,
    customer.FirstName AS first_name,
    customer.LastName AS last_name,
    MEASURE(online_sales.order_count) AS order_cnt,
    MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amt
  FROM online_sales
  CROSS JOIN customer

ranked AS (
  SELECT

    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_customers

)
SELECT

  CASE
    WHEN (first_name IS NULL OR first_name = 'Not Provided')
     AND (last_name IS NULL OR last_name = 'Not Provided')
      THEN CAST(customer_key AS TEXT)
    ELSE TRIM(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(first_name, 'Not Provided'), '') || ' ' ||
      COALESCE(NULLIF(last_name, 'Not Provided'), '')

  END AS customer_name,
  order_cnt AS order_count,
  aov AS average_order_value,
  order_rank,
  aov_rank
FROM ranked

  FROM online_sales

statuses AS (
  SELECT
    l8.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
    CASE
      WHEN dateDiff('month', l8.last_2008_date, DATE '2008-12-31') <= 6 THEN '活跃'
      WHEN dateDiff('month', l8.last_2008_date, DATE '2008-12-31') <= 12 THEN '有流失风险'
      ELSE '已流失'
    END AS initial_status,
    CASE
      WHEN dateDiff('month', l9.last_2009_date, DATE '2009-12-31') <= 6 THEN '活跃'
      WHEN dateDiff('month', l9.last_2009_date, DATE '2009-12-31') <= 12 THEN '有流失风险'
      ELSE '已流失'
    END AS final_status
  FROM last_2008 l8
  JOIN last_2009 l9
    ON l8.CustomerKey = l9.CustomerKey
),
transitions AS (
  SELECT
    initial_status,
    final_status,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM statuses
  GROUP BY initial_status, final_status
),
status_domain AS (
  SELECT '活跃' AS status, 1 AS ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '有流失风险' AS status, 2 AS ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '已流失' AS status, 3 AS ord
)

  i.status AS initial_status,
  f.status AS final_status,
  COALESCE(t.customer_count, 0) AS customer_count
FROM status_domain i
CROSS JOIN status_domain f
LEFT JOIN transitions t
  ON t.initial_status = i.status
 AND t.final_status = f.status
ORDER BY i.ord, f.ord;

    GROUP BY online_sales.CustomerKey

                THEN '活跃'
            WHEN (2008 * 12 + 12)

                THEN '有流失风险'
            ELSE '已流失'
        END AS initial_status,
        CASE
            WHEN (2009 * 12 + 12)
                 - (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p9.last_2009) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p9.last_2009)) <= 6
                THEN '活跃'
            WHEN (2009 * 12 + 12)
                 - (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p9.last_2009) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p9.last_2009)) <= 12
                THEN '有流失风险'
            ELSE '已流失'
        END AS final_status
    FROM last_purchase_2008 p8
    JOIN last_purchase_2009 p9
      ON p8.customer_key = p9.customer_key
),
transition_counts AS (
    SELECT
        initial_status,
        final_status,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count
    FROM customer_status
    GROUP BY initial_status, final_status
),
status_list AS (
    SELECT '活跃' AS status_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '有流失风险'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '已流失'
)
SELECT
    sl_i.status_name AS initial_status,
    sl_f.status_name AS final_status,
    COALESCE(tc.customer_count, 0) AS customer_count
FROM status_list sl_i
CROSS JOIN status_list sl_f
LEFT JOIN transition_counts tc
  ON tc.initial_status = sl_i.status_name
 AND tc.final_status = sl_f.status_name
ORDER BY
    CASE sl_i.status_name
        WHEN '活跃' THEN 1
        WHEN '有流失风险' THEN 2
        WHEN '已流失' THEN 3
    END,
    CASE sl_f.status_name
        WHEN '活跃' THEN 1
        WHEN '有流失风险' THEN 2
        WHEN '已流失' THEN 3
    END;

WITH customer_first AS (

         MIN(online_sales.DateKey) AS first_date
  FROM online_sales
  GROUP BY online_sales.CustomerKey

customer_year_flags AS (
  SELECT online_sales.CustomerKey AS customer_key,
         MAX(CASE WHEN online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2008-01-01' AND online_sales.DateKey < DATE '2009-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bought_2008,
         MAX(CASE WHEN online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01' AND online_sales.DateKey < DATE '2010-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bought_2009
  FROM online_sales
  GROUP BY online_sales.CustomerKey
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT cf.customer_key,
         cy.bought_2008,
         cy.bought_2009
  FROM customer_first cf
  JOIN customer_year_flags cy
    ON cf.customer_key = cy.customer_key
  WHERE cf.first_date >= DATE '2007-01-01'
    AND cf.first_date < DATE '2008-01-01'
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS base_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bought_2008 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS customers_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bought_2008 = 1 AND bought_2009 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS customers_2009_after_2008
  FROM cohort
)
SELECT
  '2008 年回购（2007 首购客户中）' AS stage,
  customers_2008 AS customers,
  base_customers AS denominator,
  ROUND(100.0 * customers_2008 / NULLIF(base_customers, 0), 2) AS retention_pct
FROM summary
UNION ALL
SELECT
  '2009 年再次购买（2008 回购客户中）' AS stage,
  customers_2009_after_2008 AS customers,
  customers_2008 AS denominator,
  ROUND(100.0 * customers_2009_after_2008 / NULLIF(customers_2008, 0), 2) AS retention_pct
FROM summary;

WITH product_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    online_sales.ProductKey AS product_key,
    MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS revenue
  FROM online_sales
  WHERE online_sales.DateKey >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND online_sales.DateKey <= DATE '2009-12-31'
  GROUP BY online_sales.ProductKey
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    product_key,
    revenue,
    SUM(revenue) OVER (
      ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_key
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_revenue,
    SUM(revenue) OVER () AS total_revenue
  FROM product_revenue
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    product_key,
    CASE
      WHEN (cumulative_revenue - revenue) < 0.80 * total_revenue THEN 'A'
      WHEN (cumulative_revenue - revenue) < 0.95 * total_revenue THEN 'B'
      ELSE 'C'
    END AS abc_class
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  abc_class,
  COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class;

  FROM quarterly

)

    - MAX(CASE WHEN day_type = 'WorkDay' THEN avg_daily_sales END), 2

  ROUND(
    (

      - MAX(CASE WHEN day_type = 'WorkDay' THEN avg_daily_sales END)
